claim_boundary: The pinned Tripo candidate is locally exported, image-conditioned textured, fitted to the production Unity canopy slot, rendered through InkLit/outline with corrected glTF texture coordinates, and verified in a standalone runtime sweep. The segmented export is retained only as the eye-selection guide. Both GLBs and the generated prefab remain local ignored assets; no art-library publication, clean-checkout asset restoration, final retopology, LOD, or collision release is claimed.

preserves: existing lower cockpit cradle and jaw
replacement_scope.rule: Replace the source canopy mesh; never place this candidate over or inside a still-visible copy of the blue canopy.

identity.geometric_principle: A skull with the cranium above the jaw missing: a thin attachment perimeter around a deep, explicitly concave machine cavity.
required_features: deep concave socket silhouette in side view
missing upper cranium rather than a canopy shell
thin attachment perimeter matching the source canopy footprint
orange braided conduits following the inner cavity walls
small pupil-less seven-aperture core recessed behind the rim
lower edge compatible with the existing jaw cradle
forbidden_features: opaque cap across the upper opening
human face or single organic eyeball
full mech body in the generated part

tripo_candidate.visual_review: Front and rotated profile retain a recessed bowl/socket with the rim forward of the core.

tripo_texture_pass.source: the same four front/left/right/back multiview images used to generate the candidate

tripo_segmentation.use: eye-selection guide only; not the Unity texture source

eye.runtime_boundary: the corresponding textured-v4 mesh region is extracted to a separate recentered pivot with independent yaw/pitch animation

unity_runtime.material_policy: the shell and extracted eye share the original Tripo 4096x4096 texture, retain double-sided rendering, use MechGame/InkLit, and use the screen-outline rendering layer; glTF V coordinates are inverted for Unity texture space; the eye alone reaches 9.0 HDR emission with an 18-pixel 0.42-intensity texture-space spread plus one eye-bound camera-facing additive optical halo, while shell emission remains 0.0
unity_runtime.replacement_policy: only the original canopy panels are hidden; chassis visibility, materials, and rendering layers remain unchanged

production_gates: publish the hash-pinned 4K textured GLB, segmentation guide, and generated runtime prefab through the private art inventory and Unity asset contract after explicit authorization
verify a fresh checkout can bootstrap the published source and generated prefab
complete final artist-approved retopology, LOD, and collision policy for release
